comment: I would not recommend. Very unclear grading policies!
I cried too many times over this class
Won't be taking again.
Not super responsive. Pretty inflexible yet changing expectations and criteria a lot. Wouldn't take again. Had a lot of hope for him, too.

Genuinely the worst professor I've ever had. Unclear on instructions, unresponsive, not at all grade-transparent, and generally not helpful. If you can, AVOID THIS CLASS. You cannot do well, nor does it feel like he wants you to.

this class is an easy A, so if that's what you're looking for, i would recommend taking this. dr hidalgo is a great guy, and obviously very intelligent, but i did not learn anything in this class. it is mastery based, which is easy, but very tedious. just make sure you don't fall behind on the mastery checks and leave them until the last minute.

I took Dr. Hidalgo's LEAF (leadership ethics applied in field) class and 10/10 recommend as an elective. Class is about public speaking but do not let that deter you if you dislike speaking, as this class gives you the skills to be a public speaker.

I loved Hidalgo's critical thinking class. It is self-paced and mastery based, so you are guaranteed to do well if you put in time and effort to complete assignments. He cares about helping students learn and is accessible outside of class time.

Dr. Hidalgo is an amazing professor. I had him for both critical thinking and leadership ethics. He is very educated and passionate about the topics he teaches, and welcomes a variety of perspectives into the classroom. I would absolutely recommend taking a class with him. It will not be easy, but you will learn a lot and he will always support you

Amazing professor and my favorite so far. This class was not like anything I've taken before; it was so fun and all discussion based. I looked forward to coming every day and got so much out of it. There's readings and a few papers/speeches -- it's manageable. He cares a lot about his students and is very involved. Office hours are so helpful.

Critical Thinking with Dr. Hidalgo was one of my favorite classes I've taken. The class is self-paced, and it is designed for you to learn. The only way to not get an A+ is by not doing the work and showing up.
He's a great teacher, but you need to pay a lot of attention to his work in order to get good grade.

The whole class was work at your own pace. So you can miss class if you need to or you can work ahead and finish the class early in the semester. Easy to finish early if you put the work in early in the semester. He has an interesting approach to critical thinking and you learn something new. Very nice guy and understanding of student needs.

While difficult and reading-intensive, Dr. Hidalgo made this FYS very rewarding. I looked forward to class every day. His criteria for grading were clear and I never was caught off guard. He was available out of class more than any other prof and was always kind and helpful. I would highly recommend Dr. Hidalgo: the highlight of my semester.

Dr. Hidalgo is a really great professor and is really knowledgable. He is a really tough grader though and most people end up with Bs in his class. Is the type of professor to take off points for basically no reason just because he believes As are limited to perfection.

Dr. Hidalgo gives a lot of reading outside of class. Like a LOT. He grades papers harshly but he gives you an opportunity to revise two of them. He is happy to meet with you outside of class to work on an outline of your paper. I found the class kind of boring, but then again I had the class on a Friday afternoon.
Super awesome professor! I took his FYS and definitely want to take more classes with him.

Dr. Hidalgo is a great professor and his class was easily my favorite class I took this semester. I most appreciated how he did not try to indoctrinate students with his ideas but rather was open to any thoughts of his students as long as they were well thought out and rational. Definitely take him. I sure will be in the future

Dr. Hidalgo is one of the smartest people I have ever met. His class is incredibly captivating and very discussion based but not difficult to participate in. Very helpful if you go to his office hours. An A is attainable but he'll make you work for it. I will absolutely be searching for more classes of his to take in the future.

Dr. Hidalgo taught one of the best classes I have ever taken. I was pretty set that I wanted to major in business but after taking his class I have really developed an interest in leadership. Incredible teacher, great atmosphere. Hands down best decision I have made in my first year here. Couldn't speak more highly of him and his class. Take it.
